notes:
BLOCKED on HELPER_MISSING: the pinned repository is a multi-drone Gazebo/ArduPilot SITL launch environment whose only shipped flight-control implementation is a Python Tk GUI over MAVLink, not a ROS node. RosDriver binds only rosbridge ROS topics, services and actions; the clone declares no ROS flight-control service, action or topic.

CONTROL: the only shipped control code is src/multiagent_simulation/multiagent_simulation/move_drone.py. It imports customtkinter and pymavlink (lines 4-5), opens a MAVLink UDP connection to udp:127.0.0.1:14550 (line 7), and sends MAVLink commands for mode (13-15), arm (17-18), takeoff (20-27), a body-offset position setpoint (29-42) and land (44-50). The module builds a Tk GUI at import (64-123) and is installed as the move_drone console script (src/multiagent_simulation/setup.py:45-51); it is not a class, it is not importable without side effects, and it is not a ROS endpoint.

ROS SURFACE: the cloned ROS endpoints are one-way Gazebo-to-ROS observations. src/multiagent_simulation/config/multiagent_lidar_camera_bridge.yaml has 14 active entries, all with direction GZ_TO_ROS (lines 2-99; directions at 6, 11, 16, 21, 26, 31, 36, 41, 46, 51, 57, 69, 79 and 99); the image bridges are ros_gz_image image_bridge remaps (src/multiagent_simulation/launch/multiagent_simulation.launch.py:270-316). The launch starts external ros_gz_sim, ardupilot_sitl, ros_gz_bridge, ros_gz_image and topic_tools nodes (src/multiagent_simulation/launch/multiagent_simulation.launch.py:118-145, 182-228, 254-268 and 319-356) and declares no ROS service or action endpoint for step, pause, reset, arm, takeoff or land. The only ROS-to-ArduPilot path the clone configures is the generic topic_tools relay from tf to ap/tf (src/multiagent_simulation/launch/multiagent_simulation.launch.py:343-355), which feeds external odometry to ArduPilot (README.md:130-134), not a flight command, and has no application acknowledgement. src/multiagent_simulation/package.xml:19 lists rclpy as an exec dependency, but no Python file imports rclpy and no in-repo file defines a ROS node class, service or action; the only shipped executable module is move_drone.py. src/multiagent_simulation/setup.py:45-51 also declares fly_trajectory and initialization_flight console scripts, but those modules do not exist in the pinned tree (only move_drone.py is present). The test directory contains only the three ament linter tests (src/multiagent_simulation/test/test_copyright.py:15-25, src/multiagent_simulation/test/test_flake8.py:15-25 and src/multiagent_simulation/test/test_pep257.py:15-23), not a functional simulator test.

WHY NO DRIVER: RosDriver could bind the observation topics, but that would replace the environment's primary control and step interface with sensor metadata, which the task rules forbid. A direct Driver is not a port either: the clone has no Python device class (MHS/registry/repos/robots/aau-cns__ardupilot_multiagent_simulation.json:38 records NO_ENTRY_SYMBOL), pymavlink is not a declared dependency in src/multiagent_simulation/package.xml:10-19 and is not installed in this workspace, and a native.py would have to invent a MAVLink client outside the upstream class. A fake-only pass would fabricate the control surface the gate checks.

SAFETY: the shipped control can take off and fly a simulated multirotor, a mobile base, so any implemented driver would be at least R2 (MHS/spec/04-safety.md:68). At R2 an independent stop or a source-backed safe-state action is required (MHS/sdk/docs/driver-authoring.md:266-267 and 341). The clone's only stop-like path is the fire-and-forget MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND send at move_drone.py:44-50; it waits for no COMMAND_ACK, sends no disarm, has no ROS binding and is not independent of the same MAVLink link. The launch has no pause, stop or reset service or action. The clone therefore does not provide a source-backed stop that the helper can declare.

No gate run was made because no honest driver.py or fake.py can be built from this interface; a failing report would only restate the missing driver. No network, pip install, upstream execution or hardware was used. The clone remains unmodified at 53f37bc3af9b24c41c732dbf46d9f32bd0a5c88d. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none in shape because no shape can be selected; the card's RosDriver helper cannot express the MAVLink control runtime and needs separate routing. NOT COVERED: all simulation, flight-control, sensor and deployment behavior.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the block after checking the author's claims against the clone: the only Python module is move_drone.py, a customtkinter GUI that opens a pymavlink UDP connection at import (move_drone.py:4-7) and sends mode, arm, takeoff, body-offset position and LAND commands without waiting for any acknowledgement (13-50); no file imports rclpy; the bridge configuration has 14 active entries, all GZ_TO_ROS (multiagent_lidar_camera_bridge.yaml), and the console scripts fly_trajectory and initialization_flight name modules absent from the tree (setup.py:45-51). The launch starts Gazebo, ros_gz and image bridges, topic_tools relays and, per drone, ArduPilot SITL with its DDS interface through ardupilot_sitl's sitl_dds_udp.launch.py and a micro-ROS agent (multiagent_simulation.launch.py:182-228), whose ROS 2 endpoints are defined in ArduPilot outside the clone; the only ArduPilot topic the clone names is the ap/tf odometry relay (343-355). No RosDriver can bind a cited flight control or stop, and the observation-only alternative was rightly refused. Like the skipped gh.khancyr/ardupilot_gazebo and gh.radarku/sitl-swarm, the repository is a SITL launch environment whose vehicles fly through ArduPilot SITL (the gh.ardupilot/ardupilot card), so the reviewer proposes a skip override. The reviewer changed no authored file; the reviewer's gate run created check-report.json (G1, G2, G3 and G9 fail because there is no package; stable digest sha256:c1fff8ec784375d39b527952491da09d2eb824f9624fc926d5623fe8fc206e8a). For the human reviewer: No package code exists. A live use of this environment flies simulated ArduPilot copters through MAVLink (the move_drone GUI connects to udp:127.0.0.1:14550) or through ArduPilot's own ROS 2 DDS interface, both outside the clone; the GUI's LAND is a fire-and-forget MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND with no acknowledgement and no disarm, so it is not a stop. A package for these vehicles belongs to the ArduPilot MAVLink route and needs an acknowledged, sensed stop.
